name: Spiked Shield, Heavy or Light
body:
Cost +10 gp Weight +5 lbs.

These spikes turn a shield into a martial piercing weapon and increase the damage dealt by a shield bash as if the shield were designed for a creature one size category larger than you. You can’t put spikes on a buckler or a tower shield. Otherwise, attacking with a spiked shield is like making a shield bash attack.

Spiked Light Shield

Cost 13 gp (wooden)/19 gp (steel) Weight 10 lbs. (wooden)/11 lbs. (steel)
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium) Critical x2 Type piercing
Category light Proficiency martial
Weapon Groups close, tribal

Spiked Heavy Shield

Cost 17 gp (wooden)/30 gp (steel) Weight 15 lbs. (wooden)/20 lbs. (steel)
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium) Critical x2 Type piercing
Category one-handed Proficiency martial
Weapon Groups close, tribal
